event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 63 and 181
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,710 parameters at 99.030000%, a +0.030000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 27 prior macro-attempts in this family and 400 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0085/micro-0014 at 1710 parameters and 99.030000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0081/micro-0007 (discard, 98.970000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 63 and 181, values -0.0254053138 and -0.0253581516 (difference 4.716e-05), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,709 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 5.810e-05) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
